claims.quote: The red cherry rasbora, Rasbora lacrimula, is a small cyprinid confirmed only from the Belayan drainage in east Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo.
The only confirmed record is from the type locality in the Ulu (river) Belayan drainage, part of the lower Mahakam drainage in Kalimantan Timur (east Kalimantan), Indonesian Borneo.
